q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT A.EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(ID) AS COUNTT FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS A WHERE A.COUNTT > 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT A.EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(ID) AS COUNTT FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS A WHERE A.COUNTT > 1
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are designed to find emails that are associated with more than one person in the PERSON table. They achieve this by grouping the records by email and then filtering out the groups where the count of IDs (i.e., the number of people) is greater than 1.
